title: Final Cadence Examiner
text: Final Cadence Examiner tests each voice against a perfect closing note and condemns every living variation. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: Perfection leaves no room to breathe.

defeatReward.text: Final Cadence Examiner is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
